counts.population: Unanimous-295 set, with per-task metrics for nine models in one JSON file

dataset_profile.notes: Archive and cost-file counts come from a script over the pinned Hub file list; the card's tables link 39 of the 97 archives, so one benchmark set uses a subset of the archives. The sets differ in size (295, 50, 52, 26 and 38 tasks) and some tables use different tracks and measurement contracts, which the card says limits comparison across them. Mean scores include verifier partial credit; strict passes use recorded verdicts.

data.reason: Neither the card metadata nor its text declares a license, and the file list at this revision has no license file, so no data grant is established; agent outputs, screenshots and logged third-party content keep their own terms.

name: CUA Speedrun results
notes: The publishing account is anonymous (anonymousmypcbench). The card names the benchmark sets used by CUA Speedrun but cites no paper, and neither the cua-speedrun paper, its project page nor its GitHub README links this repository, so no relation to the paper is asserted. Scores, task times and costs are the publisher's measurements; several costs are API-equivalent token estimates, and the card keeps two Kimi K3 OSWorld2 evaluations as billing-affected recordings. Screenshots for five September evaluations were deleted before publication. No license is declared.
summary: Trajectory archives and per-task results from CUA Speedrun evaluations of computer-use models on OSWorld subsets, CUA-World and MyPCBench, with verifier scores, measured task times and recorded or estimated costs.
